moveCard.description: Move this server into a different project. Members of the current project lose access and members of the new project gain it.
moveCard.confirmDescription: {{name}} will be moved to {{project}}. Members of the current project and its project API keys lose access to it. Database credentials the server uses stay pointed at the current project's databases.

templateCard.description: Switches the server to another template. The new template starts from its own defaults — nothing of the current configuration carries over, and the startup variables are reset.
templateCard.backupFirstHint: Needs backup permission and a free backup slot. The switch is abandoned if the backup fails.
templateCard.wipeAllHint: Deletes everything on the server, so the new template starts clean. Leftover world data usually breaks the new template.
templateCard.stoppedWarning: Backing up and wiping need the server to be stopped — stop it first, or the switch is refused.
templateCard.portsWarning: Port allocations are kept as they are. The new template usually expects different ports, so review them under Ports afterwards.
templateCard.switchDescription: The server's startup configuration is replaced by {{template}}'s defaults and pushed to its node. It takes effect the next time the server starts.
templateCard.wipeYes: Every file on the server is deleted
templateCard.wipeNo: Files are kept as they are
